name: Conrad Schlenkhoff
headline: Keynotes, Courses & Consulting- from Basics to AI-Strategy & Implementation
summary: As a dynamic and analytical executive with ten years of experience in digital businesses (digital strategy, product development, operations), I've thrived on mastering complex challenges and delivering extraordinary results. My journey has been marked by a structured approach, robust communication skills, and a deep technical understanding—qualities that colleagues and team members deeply appreciate in our pursuit of shared objectives. With the founding of the AI Transformation Institute, I'm channeling this passion and expertise into driving AI education, developing AI-powered solutions, leveraging humor and common ground to foster innovation and collaboration.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
Our courses empower you to evaluate the latest developments in AI and apply them to your needs. Whether you're a c-level manager, marketing expert, legal professional - we can help you understand AI. 

Using Chat GPT per se does not make you an AI expert. Employees need to further their qualifications. Especially in generative AI and large language models (LLMs) it is important to recognize potentials and risks and to apply the latest tools. Our customized courses are developed and led by renowned experts from business and science.

company.name: AI Transformation Institute
company.description:
Our courses empower you to evaluate the latest developments in AI and apply them to your needs. Whether you're a c-level manager, marketing expert, legal professional - we can help you understand AI. Using ChatGPT per se does not make you an AI expert. Employees need to further their qualifications. Especially in generative AI and large language models (LLMs) it is important to recognize potentials and risks, and to apply the latest tools. Our customized courses are developed and led by renowned experts from business and science.  

As a spin-off of the German Research Centre for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI), we have the knowledge, experience and, above all, the experts that companies and professionals need to master the AI transformation through education and consultancy. 
DFKI, the largest independent AI research center worldwide, leads groundbreaking efforts to develop reliable and trustworthy AI, securing a leading role for Germany and Europe in the 
international competition.
